title: Intelectron hearing device for the deaf

tellings.quote: basically they designed a a device which would enable deaf people to to

plain: Around 1962 and 1963, a company in New York City called Intelectron is said to have designed a device meant to help deaf people. A researcher named Greg Malatzi brings it up in passing, without naming a source, while talking about a scientist said to have worked with the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, and his own sentence breaks off before he says exactly what the device did.
